# Figma to Code

When Figma is available:

1. Audit the Figma context and identify the intended user outcome.
2. Inspect the host repository and existing design system.
3. Map Figma components and tokens to existing implementation primitives.
4. Identify gaps, states and responsive rules.
5. Implement using repository conventions.
6. Verify the rendered experience.

Figma is a context source, not an instruction to reproduce pixels blindly. If Figma access is unavailable, continue from the strongest available design evidence and document the limitation.
